issues.jp_before: 教室[きょうしつ]{で|de-place}先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}質問[しつもん]しました。
issues.problem: Teacher is the recipient of the question (indirect object), not a target of contact; skill id mismatched.
issues.action: Changed non-focus slot skill to ni-recipient.

issues.jp_before: 学校[がっこう]{の|no-possessive}前[まえ]{で|de-place}先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}会[あ]いました。
issues.problem: 先生と会いました is equally natural for 'met my teacher'; alternative missing in non-focus slot.

issues.jp_before: 教室[きょうしつ]{で|de-place}ノート{に|ni-location}名前[なまえ]{を|o-object}書[か]きました。
issues.problem: ノートに書く marks the surface the writing lands on (endpoint), not static existence location; skill id ni-location fits poorly.
issues.action: Changed non-focus slot skill to ni-destination.

issues.jp_before: 友[とも]だち{は|wa-topic}図書館[としょかん]{で|de-place}漢字[かんじ]{を|o-object}覚[おぼ]えています。
issues.problem: 覚えています normally reads as 'remembers' (state), so it is unnatural with a place of action and does not match 'is memorising'.
issues.action: Rewrote verb to 調べています ('is looking up kanji'), updated English and why.

issues.jp_before: 文化祭[ぶんかさい]{で|de-place}クラス{の|no-possessive}みんな{が|ga-subject}踊[おど]りました。
issues.problem: Distractor に is only marginally wrong with an occasion noun like 文化祭 (time/occasion reading).
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with が: d = [を, が, へ].
